## Why visit

A relaxed neighbourhood route into Fell’s Cumbrian brewing, especially useful if you want a dark cask alongside the pale beers common elsewhere. The small tiled-and-wood bar feels different from a production taproom and sits conveniently among Chorlton’s other serious beer stops. Its real-cider listing adds another reason to include it in a suburban circuit. The appeal is focused brewery character, a manageable selection and a setting suitable for a settled drink; it need not consume an entire afternoon on its own.

## Beer

The brewery advertises four cask lines with Fell and guest beer; CAMRA notes that a dark beer is usual, with mild and porter among the styles seen.

## Food

Snacks from independent producers; no full kitchen established.

## Plan the visit

Card only according to CAMRA. Generally opens later on weekdays; advertised coffee service does not imply the beer bar is open.

**Getting there:** Walk from Chorlton tram stop; near Chorlton Tap.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
